_comment: Shared TypeScript base for Hub modules. Modules extend this and should
only declare genuinely local settings (outDir, include/exclude).
lib includes DOM and types is explicit because @types/node 24 stopped
injecting ambient globals implicitly — without these, Buffer, URL,
node:stream and the generic ReadableStream declarations disappear and
transpile fails across generated code, hub-sdk, @aws-sdk/types and
@smithy/core. Narrowing types to [node] alone compiles src/ but breaks
the mocha e2e globals, hence both entries.
